37 A potentiometer and a driver cell of electromotive force (e.m.f.) E are used to measure the e.m.f.
of a new cell.
A sliding contact at P is moved along a resistance wire QR until the reading on the galvanometer
is zero.
driver cell
E
Q
R
P
new cell
What is an essential requirement for the e.m.f. of the new cell to be measured accurately?
A
The e.m.f. of the driver cell must be less than the e.m.f. of the new cell.
B
The galvanometer must have a large resistance.
C
The internal resistance of the new cell must be zero.
D
The resistance per unit length of the wire QR must be constant.

hints: Notice the null condition in the diagram with sliding contact P on wire QR: zero galvanometer current means the e.m.f. of the new cell equals the potential difference across length QP.
Recall the driver current produces that potential difference as $V = IR$, so $V_{QP}$ depends on the resistance of section QP.
Ask what must be true about wire QR for resistance of QP to be strictly proportional to measured length QP when P is moved.
walkthrough: Identify the balance condition: P is adjusted until galvanometer current is zero, so no current flows in the lower loop containing the new cell.
State the physical rule: with zero current, there is no lost volts in the new cell, so e.m.f. of new cell $=$ p.d. across wire section QP.
Set up the driver circuit argument: the same driver current $I$ flows through QR, so $V_{QP} = I \times R_{QP}$ where $R_{QP}$ is the resistance from Q to P.
Connect resistance to length: $R_{QP} = k \times QP$ only if $k$, the resistance per unit length of QR, is the same everywhere along the wire.
Conclude that accurate conversion of balance length to e.m.f. requires uniform wire, and this is option D.

A.explanation: The driver must be able to balance the new cell, so $E$ must be greater than the e.m.f. of the new cell, not less.

B.explanation: At balance the galvanometer current is zero, so its resistance does not affect the balance length QP.

C.explanation: At null deflection there is no current from the new cell, so no potential is lost across its internal resistance.

D.explanation: Uniform wire makes resistance of QP proportional to length QP, so balance length gives a true measure of e.m.f.
